description: This is a test source file for HibernatePatientDAO in the OpenMRS project, containing unit tests for patient data retrieval and duplicate detection.

classes.name: HibernatePatientDAOTest
classes.description: Test class for HibernatePatientDAO, testing patient retrieval and duplicate detection functions.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Initializes DAO objects before each test run.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifiers_shouldGetByIdentifierType
methods.description: Tests retrieval of patient identifiers by identifier type.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifiers_shouldGetByPatients
methods.description: Tests retrieval of patient identifiers by patient objects.

methods.name: getDuplicatePatientsByAttributes_shouldNotReturnPatientsWithUniqueNames
methods.description: Ensures no duplicate patients are returned when names are unique.

methods.name: getDuplicatePatientsByAttributes_shouldReturnPatientsWithDuplicatedAllNames
methods.description: Checks for patients with identical name fields.

methods.name: getDuplicatePatientsByAttributes_shouldReturnPatientsWithDuplicatedFamilyNames
methods.description: Tests detection of patients sharing family names.

methods.name: getDuplicatePatientsByAttributes_shouldReturnPatientsWithDuplicatedAllFields
methods.description: Detects duplicate patients with identical name, gender, and birthdate.

methods.name: getDuplicatePatientsByAttributes_shouldNotReturnPatientsWithDuplicatedAllFieldsBesidesGender
methods.description: Ensures patients are not considered duplicates if only gender differs.

methods.name: getDuplicatePatientsByAttributes_shouldReturnPatientsWithDuplicatedAllFieldsIncludingIdentifier
methods.description: Detects duplicate patients with identical identifiers and other fields.

methods.name: getDuplicatePatientsByAttributes_shouldNotReturnVoidedPatientsWithDuplicatedAllFields
methods.description: Verifies voided patients are excluded unless includeVoided flag is used.

methods.name: getDuplicatePatientsByAttributes_shouldReturnVoidedPatientsWithDuplicatedAllFieldsWithIncludeVoided
methods.description: Tests detection of voided duplicate patients with includeVoided flag.
